text:
Before you pay anyone for SEO, try this.

Type what you sell plus your suburb into your phone. "Blocked drains Baldivis."

See a map with three local businesses on it? People near you search for what you do. SEO can bring you work.

No map? Keep your money.

Plumber in Midland paid an SEO company for a year. Page one in 90 days, they said.

He never got there.

When he went to leave, he found his Google Business Profile sat under their account. His reviews. His photos.

Log in today. Check that the owner is you.

Google's own advice: SEO needs four months to a year before you see the benefit.

Most owners hear that and say it's too slow.

Good. That wait is why SEO pays off.

Your competitors quit in month three. You keep going. By month nine, your name is the one on the map.
